exact_theorem: For Cauchy data for the Einstein vacuum equations posed on a hypersurface already inside the black-hole interior (representing the geometry just inside the event horizon), the maximal Cauchy evolution can be extended across a non-trivial piece of Cauchy horizon as a Lorentzian manifold with continuous metric. regularity: Metric continuous across the Cauchy horizon; the connection is not controlled (weak null singularities expected).
